name: Synth-pop
description: A paint for true music fans, especially for those who like electronic music. You will have a better experience "listening" to this paint on analog devices, dust off your tape deck, and get ready for battle!
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on 8th September 2018, as part of the 2018 Tankers Day celebrations. Simultaneously it was added to Containers permanently.
Synth-pop was given to all players who got 1000 or more Stars during the Star Hunt event that took place on September 8-17, 2018.

Garage description
A paint for true music fans, especially for those who like electronic music. You will have a better experience "listening" to this paint on analog devices, dust off your tape deck, and get ready for battle!
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
This paint was added to the game on 8th September 2018, as part of the 2018 Tankers Day celebrations. Simultaneously it was added to Containers permanently.
Synth-pop was given to all players who got 1000 or more Stars during the Star Hunt event that took place on September 8-17, 2018.
